questions.question: Who wrote the novel The Godfather, later filmed by Francis Ford Coppola?
questions.note: Puzo also co-wrote the screenplays with Coppola.

questions.question: Who wrote the novel Jurassic Park?
questions.note: Crichton also created the TV series ER.

questions.question: Which J. R. R. Tolkien work did Peter Jackson adapt into a trilogy released in 2001–2003?
questions.note: The Hobbit trilogy came later, in the 2010s.

questions.question: The Shawshank Redemption is based on a novella by which author?
questions.note: The novella is Rita Hayworth and Shawshank Redemption.

questions.question: Who wrote the Harry Potter books?
questions.note: Seven novels; eight films, because Deathly Hallows was split in two.

questions.question: Schindler’s List is based on a Booker Prize-winning novel by which author?
questions.note: The book is Schindler’s Ark in some editions.

questions.question: Which Agatha Christie mystery was filmed in 1974 with an all-star cast aboard a train?
questions.note: Albert Finney played Hercule Poirot; Sidney Lumet directed.

questions.question: Who wrote the novel Fight Club, later filmed by David Fincher?
questions.note: The first rule of Fight Club is you do not talk about Fight Club.

questions.question: The Devil Wears Prada is set at a fashion magazine inspired by which real publication?
questions.note: Meryl Streep’s Miranda Priestly is widely compared to Anna Wintour.

questions.question: Who wrote the play A Streetcar Named Desire, later a Marlon Brando film?
questions.note: Vivien Leigh played Blanche; Brando’s “Stella!” is the clip everyone knows.
